page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores on an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. It operates on the x86_64 architecture and includes hardware support for AVX and AVX512F vector extensions, AES cryptography, and FMA instructions. No local storage or GPU accelerators are bundled with this instance, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks reveal a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is weak, as demonstrated by the stress-ng single-core CPU test and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25 percent, alongside poor single-threaded gzip compression. However, the 32 dedicated physical cores deliver average multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU scores all placing in the middle 50 percent. Memory bandwidth tests also show average performance, though the Passmark memory score is weak.

Given its hardware profile and benchmark results, the ecs.sn1ne.8xlarge is suited for multi-threaded workloads that can leverage its 32 dedicated cores, such as software compilation, static web serving, and database operations. It also supports moderate machine learning tasks, achieving average prompt processing and text generation speeds on small to medium LLM models. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers a balanced multi-core compute density for legacy enterprise applications, though workloads requiring high single-thread performance or local NVMe storage may find it less optimal.
